scope: LOCAL FIXTURES ONLY; no Shopify merchant integration

results.name: Canonical card render: images/titles/currency and honest pending favorites; no fabricated reviews
Variant safety: only single purchasable variant; plans/rules/volume and options require PDP
Discount uses same real variant compare-at pair, no multi-variant percentage
Configured category hierarchy, breadcrumb ancestors and current collection
Facet/sort GET contract preserves selections, encoded labels and decimals, resets page
Selected removal and bounded pagination retain server-supplied URL state
No configured filters and empty collection produce honest finite empty state
Confirmed local Ajax cart sends exact variant, keeps pending lock and updates native cart icon
Rejected 422 displays server error safely, re-enables button, emits no success
Unknown POST outcome never retries or claims success and stays locked with cart link
Confirmed add with failed cart refresh remains uncertain; no automatic duplicate POST
Without JavaScript, standard product POST form and facet GET controls remain usable
Mobile disclosure keyboard Enter/Escape restores focus; editor section-load initializes
Responsive no overflow at 320/390/768/1024/1440 in adaptive/reference modes
Collection index and search-card mode use actual shared Liquid paths; empty index honest
axe WCAG A/AA scans of desktop and mobile catalog fixtures
Local labeled desktop/mobile screenshots captured, no runtime exceptions
